name: kgelster-cookie
description: Cookie-consent and CIPA exposure auditing for ecommerce stores as an agent skill: forensic consent-state capture, deterministic tracker classification, counsel-facing reporting.

plugins.name: cookie-audit
plugins.description: Captures a storefront in four consent states (no interaction, decline, accept, GPC) with isolated Playwright contexts, classifies every third-party request and cookie against a versioned vendor registry, and reports what fired pre-consent, post-decline, and despite GPC. Built for CIPA / wiretap / pen-register demand-letter triage on Shopify stores.
